five_rule: SHA256 ACEP-FDOE-V13-FIVE|project_id; first five distinct facility groups
metric: Fraction of all eligible test predictions with absolute error <=10%; five fixed projects must all pass; full coverage; MAPE and P95 no worse than baseline
quality_policy: Reject nonpositive target/gross area and net>gross; preserve missing other fields; no target outlier removal
feature_policy: Same nonmonetary inputs as v12; no costs/fees/unit prices or target-derived features; fit year-trend on training only
candidate_policy: Evaluate original v12 families plus bounded year-trend residual models, recent-window/recency-weighted models and geometric ensembles on fixed development folds only
test_exposure: 2025 source table was displayed during source discovery before protocol freeze. No 2025 performance measured or used to choose recipes. Label-blind computational selection, not an externally blinded study. No claim to absolute human-unseen labels.
test_sealing: Separate labels; do not load until model selection and blind prediction artifacts hashed; never tune or rerun for selection using 2025 outcomes
acceptance_scope: Retrospective Florida school contract cost, not tender forecast and not seven-engine approval
